name: Kawasaki Vulcan 2000
engine: 2053 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, fuel injected, belt drive
intro: Kawasaki's huge V-twin cruiser. Check the 2004 brake hose recall and the front belt pulley.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2004 Vulcan 2000s were in recall 04V367 for a brake hose.
A-002.reason: A brake hose fault can cost you braking. The repair is free.

add.title: Check the front belt pulley
add.instructions: With the cover off, check the front drive pulley teeth and the pulley nut. Owners report stripped front pulleys.
add.reason: A stripped pulley leaves you with no drive.

recalls.what: Brake hose recall on some 2004 bikes.
